column2: [intro]
In this world of cinema, I feel at home,
Crazy about films, they set my heart to roam,
From blockbusters to comedies, I adore them all,
Nothing beats a good movie to lift my mood and enthrall.
I’m a film buff, and it puts me in a trance,
When the lights go down, my heart starts to dance,
Popcorn in hand, I settle in my chair,
At the movies, I escape and feel the fire flare.
From Hitchcock to Tarantino, I know every name,
From tasty dialogues to scenes that bring the pain,
I laugh, I cry, I dive into each tale,
In the realm of the seventh art, I’m always on the trail.
I’m a film buff, and it puts me in a trance,
When the lights go down, my heart starts to dance,
Popcorn in hand, I settle in my chair,
At the movies, I escape and feel the fire flare.
